deploy.startCommand: sh -c 'export DIRECT_URL="${DIRECT_URL:-$DATABASE_URL}" && node packages/database/scripts/wait-for-database.js && node packages/database/scripts/resolve-failed-migration.js && pnpm --filter @keeper/database run migrate:deploy:railway && echo "=== Migration complete, running seeds ===" && (pnpm --filter @keeper/database run seed:railway || echo "⚠️ Seed failed after retries (non-fatal on Railway — DB already seeded); starting API") && echo "=== Starting server ===" && node apps/api/dist/index.js'
